en: Black‑and‑white aerial or elevated view over a dense historic town with steep tiled roofs, a church tower with a clock in the foreground, a central market‑square area, and a long multi‑arched stone bridge crossing a broad river in the background. Beyond the river lie fields and low hills. On one of the buildings near the square the name 'Emil Ranpf' is visible, along with other German signage on facades.
